## Summary

**Verified and documented in REVIEW.md:**

**Critical blockers (5):** No client UI at all—the HTML stub is empty with no JavaScript. Unauthenticated sign-in accepts any staffId/manager claim. Managers have no endpoint to discover claims awaiting approval. Concurrent JSON writes risk data corruption. Manager authorization checks don't validate line-manager relationships.

**Moderate issues (3):** Session secret defaults to insecure value. Single test with minimal coverage. HTTPS requirement incompatible with "internal network only."

**What works:** Backend API endpoints exist, input validation present, basic data persistence functional, one test passes.

**Release verdict:** **NOT production-ready.** Do not deploy Monday. Estimated 3–5 days to address security gaps, implement UI, complete workflows, and add atomic writes.
